## Screenshots

Visual changes require before and after screenshots of each affected page or component. Use matching viewport sizes and page states, and include desktop and mobile views when affected. For changes without visual impact, replace this section with "Not applicable".

Capture matching images with the [screenshot script](https://github.com/Strange-Lasers/strangelasers.com/blob/main/scripts/screenshots.mjs). See [setup and options](https://github.com/Strange-Lasers/strangelasers.com/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#before-and-after-screenshots).

```sh
npm run screenshots -- ../before-checkout . --page /about/ --selector '#bismeet'
```
